test_item_verbatim: · The Head Unit shall gate BH-CAN IPC_VEHICLE_SETUP.DynamicGrid to LVDS gridZoomRequest.DynamicGridRQSts a) The Head Unit shall gate BH-CAN IPC_VEHICLE_SETUP.DynamicGrid = [Dynamic Gridlines OFF] to LVDS gridZoomRequest.DynamicGridRQSts = [OFF]

tcs.tc_title: DynamicGridRQSts = OFF (Atl-Mi), set the CAN signal and read the LVDS signal
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The HU is in the Full-Operation state
2. PROXI Rear_View_Camera = 1 (Present)
3. A bus analyzer is connected to the LVDS link between the HU and the RVCM
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Send CAN: IPC_VEHICLE_SETUP.DynamicGrid = 0 (Dynamic Gridlines OFF)
2. Read gridZoomRequest.DynamicGridRQSts and check that it is OFF
tcs.expected_result:
1. IPC_VEHICLE_SETUP.DynamicGrid = 0 (Dynamic Gridlines OFF) is sent
2. gridZoomRequest.DynamicGridRQSts = OFF is sent over LVDS
tcs.test_item:
· The Head Unit shall gate BH-CAN IPC_VEHICLE_SETUP.DynamicGrid to LVDS gridZoomRequest.DynamicGridRQSts a) The Head Unit shall gate BH-CAN IPC_VEHICLE_SETUP.DynamicGrid = [Dynamic Gridlines OFF] to LVDS gridZoomRequest.DynamicGridRQSts = [OFF]

(DynamicGridRQSts = OFF (Atl-Mi), set the CAN signal and read the LVDS signal)

reasoning: 驗證目標為 `SYS-RA-VF551_V3-284` 之 `a)` 分支。上半為摘句（§4.3.1）：原句 78 token 逾 50，刪其餘三個子句後為 28 token，為原句之保序子序列，主句（gating 之宣告）與本分支之來源值與標的值皆保留。**CAN 側可逐字書寫**：376 之 `IPC_VEHICLE_SETUP` 為 `BO_ 1468`（`forms/P363_BH-CAN [07338]_3A_R2.dbc`），其 `VAL_` 與 Atl-Hi 之 `BO_ 1443` 同值域。依 **R-CAM15(b)**，V42（637）於本驗證點有對應條文（`V42-319`／`-320`），故 V3 列只承 376。LVDS 訊號無 DBC（四本零命中），其值以來源 label 逐字書寫、觀察以 bus analyzer 進行，**不造命令**（profile §7.2／§7.3）。
